plugins.name: starzero
plugins.description: Upload media to StarZero, search transcripts and visuals, run workflow templates, cut podcast clips and share renders through the starzero CLI, or through the StarZero connector on claude.ai chat.

skills.name: chat
skills.description: Edits video and hands library-wide work to the StarZero agent: cuts, trims, reframing, captions, voiceover, music, graphics, generated clips, and analysis across a whole library. An edit of a video in a StarZero library happens here, not with local tools; a local recording joins a library through ingest-media first when the user wants it edited by the agent. Use when the user says "trim this to 60 seconds", "make it 9:16", "add captions", "add a lower-third", "edit this video", "make a highlight reel", "add a voiceover", "analyse the whole library" or "continue my chat".
skills.description_zh: 通过 StarZero 智能体编辑库内视频及分析整库，涵盖剪切、重构画幅、字幕、配音、音乐、图形和生成片段。库内编辑由此完成，本地录制需先经 ingest-media 加入库。

skills.name: find-moments
skills.description: Finds moments in a StarZero library: searches transcripts for what was said and visuals for what is on screen, returns time ranges, then pulls out a frame, a signed URL, a download, or one preview video of the hits. Use when the user says "find where they talk about", "search my library for", "which clip shows", "grab a frame at", "download the original", or "compile those moments".
skills.description_zh: 在 StarZero 库中搜索转录内容和屏幕视觉，返回时间范围，并提取画面、签名链接、下载或命中片段预览视频。

skills.name: ingest-media
skills.description: Gets video or audio into a StarZero library until it is processed and searchable, from local files or from video URLs (YouTube, Google Drive, Frame.io, Facebook): picks or creates the library and folder, dry-runs uploads for dedup and the credit estimate, asks before billing, uploads or imports, then watches processing. Use when the user says "upload these files to StarZero", "add this YouTube link to my library", "import these videos", "is my footage done processing", "create a library", or "make a folder".
skills.description_zh: 从本地或 YouTube、Drive、Frame.io、Facebook 等 URL 导入 StarZero 库，选择创建目录，先预演去重及额度估算，计费前询问，上传后跟踪至处理可搜索。

skills.name: podcast-clips
skills.description: Cuts one processed StarZero media item into short social clips. Sets clip count, length, aspect, pacing, captions and music with the user (or --auto), confirms billing, starts the podcast-clips run, watches it and returns the clip render ids and links. Use when the user says "make clips from this podcast", "cut this into shorts", "vertical clips for TikTok" or "reels from this interview".
skills.description_zh: 将单个已处理 StarZero 媒体裁成社交短片，与用户确定数量、时长、比例、节奏、字幕和音乐或使用 auto，确认计费后运行跟踪并返回渲染编号及链接。

skills.name: run-workflow
skills.description: Runs an existing StarZero workflow template. Describes it, builds the variables JSON, picks the media, confirms billing, starts and watches the instance, then returns the app link, branch chat links and render ids. Use when the user says "run the workflow", "start an instance of template", "what variables does this template need", "is my run finished" or "cancel the run".
skills.description_zh: 运行已有 StarZero 工作流模板，解释模板、生成变量 JSON、选素材，确认计费后启动跟踪并返回应用、分支聊天链接及渲染编号，也支持查状态或取消。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Installs and authenticates the starzero CLI: downloads the pinned binary and ffprobe, logs in through the browser (or an API key), checks the stored credential with auth status, compares its scopes with the jobs the user wants, and shows the credit balance. Use when the user says "set up starzero", "log in to StarZero", "my login expired", "no API key", "how many credits do I have", "which scopes do I need", or after any starzero skill exits 3.
skills.description_zh: 安装固定版本 starzero CLI 和 ffprobe，通过浏览器或 API key 认证，检查已存凭据、范围与任务匹配及额度。适用于设置、登录过期或其他技能退出码 3。

skills.name: share-render
skills.description: Turns a StarZero render id into a public share page link to send, or a signed private mp4 or thumbnail URL to download, each with an expiry, and finds render ids from a workflow run, podcast run or chat. Use when the user says "give me a link to the video", "share the clips", "download the output", "where are my rendered videos", "the share link expired" or "thumbnail of that render".
skills.description_zh: 将 StarZero 渲染编号转为有期限的公开分享页或私有签名 MP4/缩略图链接，并从工作流、播客或聊天运行查找编号。适用于分享、下载和过期链接更新。
